sections.Profile:
Barb Wire pinball, produced by Gottlieb in April 1996, is based on the movie of the same name featuring Pamela Anderson. Designed by Bill Parker, this machine was the last produced by Gottlieb before the company shut down.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1996
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: DMD
- Players: 4
- Tags: Licensed, 1990s, Solid State
